title: Fine-grained crack segmentation for high-resolution images via a multiscale cascaded network
mechanism: Coarse-to-fine multiscale cascade for fine-grained cracks in high-resolution UAV images.
evidence: R: abstract only via search; numbers not read (Wiley full text unavailable off campus).
adaptation: Second stage on 2x upsampled crops around predicted crack components only, input [EL crop, upsampled crack prob]; much cheaper than the n.d. 2x global run; target width and faint ends.
min_experiment: Arm: house + crop-level 2x refiner. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: relR@2 at fixed relP@2, crack IoU. Kill: relR@2 < +0.01.
prior_overlap: Global 2x input was n.d. at 4x compute; crop-only second stage was not run.
